      PGADMIN_SERVER_JSON_FILE: /tmp/servers.json
      PGADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL: 1@1.com
      PGADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD: "1"

      PGADMIN_CONFIG_SERVER_MODE: "False"

  streamlet:
    image: ghcr.io/green-ecolution/streamlet/server:0.2.0
    environment:
      STREAMLET_ADDR: "0.0.0.0:3000"
      STREAMLET_VALHALLA_URL: "http://valhalla:8002"
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:2510:3000"
    depends_on:
      valhalla:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          cpus: "1"
          memory: 150m
        limits:
          cpus: "1"
          memory: 150m
    labels:
      - "traefik.enable=true"
      - "traefik.http.routers.streamlet.rule=Host(`streamlet.${APP_HOST:-localhost}`)"
      - "traefik.http.routers.streamlet.entrypoints=${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT:-websecure}"
  valhalla:
    image: ghcr.io/valhalla/valhalla-scripted:3.9.0
    volumes:
      - ./.docker/infra/valhalla/custom_files:/custom_files
    environment:
      server_threads: 20
    healthcheck:
      test:
        [
          "CMD",
          "curl",
          "--silent",
          "--fail-with-body",
          "--max-time",
          "5",
          "http://localhost:8002/status",
        ]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          cpus: "1"
          memory: 256m
        limits:
          cpus: "2"
          memory: 1536m
    labels:
      - "traefik.enable=true"
      - "traefik.http.routers.valhalla.rule=Host(`valhalla.${APP_HOST:-localhost}`)"
      - "traefik.http.routers.valhalla.entrypoints=${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT:-websecure}"
  reverse-proxy:
    image: traefik:v3.7.13
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
    environment:
      - PORKBUN_API_KEY=${PORKBUN_API_KEY:-}
      - PORKBUN_SECRET_API_KEY=${PORKBUN_SECRET_API_KEY:-}
    ports:
      - "${BIND_ADDR:-0.0.0.0}:3000:3000/tcp"
      - "${BIND_ADDR:-0.0.0.0}:3443:3443/tcp"
    volumes:
      - "/var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro"
      - "./.docker/infra/traefik/${TRAEFIK_CONFIG:-traefik.yaml}:/etc/traefik/traefik.yaml:ro"
      - "./.docker/infra/traefik/dynamic:/etc/traefik/dynamic:ro"
      - "./.docker/infra/traefik/certs:/etc/traefik/certs:ro"
      - "./.docker/infra/traefik/acme:/etc/traefik/acme"
    labels:
      - "traefik.enable=true"
      - "traefik.http.routers.traefik.rule=Host(`traefik.${APP_HOST:-localhost}`)"
      - "traefik.http.routers.traefik.entrypoints=${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT:-websecure}"
      - "traefik.http.routers.traefik.service=traefik"
      - "traefik.http.services.traefik.loadbalancer.server.port=8080"

  backend:
    profiles: ["app"]
    build:
      context: ./backend/
      args:
        - APP_VERSION=${APP_VERSION:-dev}
        - APP_REVISION=${APP_GIT_COMMIT:-unknown}
        - GE_GIT_COMMIT=${APP_GIT_COMMIT:-unknown}
        - GE_GIT_BRANCH=${APP_GIT_BRANCH:-unknown}
        - GE_BUILD_TIME=${APP_BUILD_TIME:-unknown}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "./green-ecolution", "healthcheck", "ready"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      start_period: 10s
      retries: 3
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      migrations:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    environment:
      - APP_ENVIRONMENT=local
      - APP_APPLICATION__HOST=0.0.0.0
      - APP_APPLICATION__PORT=3000
      - APP_APPLICATION__BASE_URL=${APP_PROTO:-https}://${APP_HOST:-localhost}:${APP_PORT:-3443}
      - APP_DATABASE__HOST=db
      - APP_DATABASE__PORT=5432
      - APP_DATABASE__DATABASE_NAME=${POSTGRES_DB:-postgres}
      - APP_DATABASE__USERNAME=${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}
      - APP_DATABASE__PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-postgres}
      - APP_LOG__LEVEL=info,sqlx=warn,tower_http=info
      - APP_LOG__FORMAT=json
      - APP_AUTH__ENABLED=true
      - APP_AUTH__ISSUER_URL=${APP_PROTO:-http}://auth.${APP_HOST:-localhost}:${APP_PORT:-3443}/realms/green-ecolution
      - APP_AUTH__FRONTEND_CLIENT_ID=frontend
      - APP_AUTH__BACKEND_CLIENT_ID=backend
      - APP_AUTH__BACKEND_CLIENT_SECRET=cVBGgWNlbwSLydLZfZMvTvmNCeiSmLGP
      - APP_AUTH__JWKS_REFRESH_INTERVAL_SECS=3600
      - APP_AUTH__JWKS_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_SECS=5
      - APP_AUTH__DEFAULT_REDIRECT_URL=${APP_PROTO:-https}://${APP_HOST:-localhost}:${APP_PORT:-3443}/auth/callback
      # routing (Valhalla/Vroom), MQTT and map config are not yet
      # implemented in backend-rs. Re-add the matching env vars once the Rust
      # Settings struct exposes those sections.
    labels:
      - "traefik.enable=true"
      - "traefik.http.routers.backend.rule=Host(`${APP_HOST:-localhost}`) && (PathPrefix(`/api`) || PathPrefix(`/swagger-ui`) || PathPrefix(`/api-docs`))"
      - "traefik.http.routers.backend.entrypoints=${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT:-websecure}"
      - "traefik.http.services.backend.loadbalancer.server.port=3000"

  frontend:
    profiles: ["app"]
    build:
      context: ./frontend
      args:
        - ENV=dev
        - BASEURL=/api
        - APP_VERSION=${APP_VERSION:-$(git describe --tags --always --dirty)}
    healthcheck:
      test:
        [
          "CMD",
          "curl",
          "--silent",
          "--fail-with-body",
          "--max-time",
          "5",
          "http://localhost:80/status",
        ]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
    depends_on:
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy
      backend:
        condition: service_started
    labels:
      - "traefik.enable=true"
      - "traefik.http.routers.frontend.rule=Host(`${APP_HOST:-localhost}`)"
      - "traefik.http.routers.frontend.entrypoints=${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT:-websecure}"
